security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown links, code fences, and documentation URLs. One command example should be corrected because an unquoted user-provided list value could be substituted into a shell command. No prompt-injection, data-exfiltration, or other intent-level security issue was found.

remediation.issue: The Resend ledger example uses an unquoted <list> placeholder in a shell command.
remediation.suggestion: Require a validated list identifier and pass it as a separately quoted argument. Do not interpolate user text into a shell command.

content.value_statement: Aging lists, bounce growth, and ignored opt-outs can reduce deliverability and create compliance concerns. This skill turns ESP exports into recency cohorts, trend checks, and a clear hygiene worklist.
actual_capabilities: Groups subscribers into active, cooling, dormant, deep-dormant, and never-engaged cohorts.
Compares hard-bounce and spam-complaint rates with a supplied baseline and benchmark.
Checks suppression-list growth and identifies possible opt-out leakage from supplied records.
Creates sized re-permission, sunset, and prune worklists from the available evidence.
Marks list-hygiene and engagement-decay reads as pass, partial, or needs-input.
Can save an approved report for the next scheduled comparison.
limitations: It relies on ESP exports, consent records, and baselines supplied by the user or connected tools.
It does not run authentication checks or calculate the full email-quality score.
It does not send campaigns, modify subscribers, or enforce suppression decisions.
Trend conclusions require a comparable prior baseline; otherwise it reports needs-input.

use_cases.title: Review a monthly newsletter list
use_cases.description: Identify inactive subscribers and prepare a measured sunset worklist before deliverability declines.

use_cases.title: Investigate rising bounce rates
use_cases.description: Compare current ESP metrics with a prior period and identify whether a send hold requires review.

use_cases.title: Reconcile opt-out handling
use_cases.description: Compare active-list and suppression records to surface possible leakage for an audit.

prompt_templates.title: Start a basic review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this newsletter list. I will provide an ESP engagement export and a bounce report. Create recency cohorts and a hygiene worklist.

prompt_templates.title: Compare with a baseline
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare this month's engagement, hard-bounce, and complaint metrics with last quarter's baseline. Mark any missing evidence as needs-input.

prompt_templates.title: Check suppression drift
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these active-list and suppression exports for drift. Identify possible opt-out leakage and prepare re-permission, sunset, and prune cohorts.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a recurring watch
prompt_templates.prompt: Set up a quarterly list-hygiene review for our retention program. Use these exports as the baseline and state what the next review must compare.

output_examples.input: A newsletter export shows 21,000 subscribers, including 3,100 never-engaged addresses and a 0.12% complaint rate.
output: A complaint-rate flag above the stated 0.1% threshold.
A sized sunset and prune worklist with an auditor handoff recommendation.

output_examples.input: A retention export has no prior baseline but includes current bounce and suppression data.
output: A point-in-time bounce and suppression read.
Trend status marked needs-input because no baseline exists.
A request for the prior comparable report before making a trend conclusion.

best_practices: Provide a dated, comparable baseline for every recurring review.
Share only the fields needed for cohorting and trend analysis.
Review suppression leakage before approving another campaign.
anti_patterns: Do not treat a missing baseline as evidence that metrics are improving.
Do not re-mail complained or hard-bounced addresses through a re-permission campaign.
Do not save reports or subscriber data without explicit approval.

faq.question: What data should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide engagement recency, bounce and complaint metrics, suppression information, and a comparable prior baseline when available.

faq.question: Does this skill send email?
faq.answer: No. It prepares analysis and worklists only.

faq.question: Can it use any ESP?
faq.answer: Yes, when you provide equivalent exports. Optional connectors may simplify retrieval for supported ESPs.

faq.question: What happens without a baseline?
faq.answer: It provides a point-in-time assessment and labels trend conclusions as needs-input.

faq.question: Does it delete subscribers?
faq.answer: No. It recommends re-permission, sunset, or prune actions for review.

faq.question: How often should I run it?
faq.answer: Use a cadence that fits your program, such as monthly for frequent promotions or quarterly for newsletters.
